purpose: Explicit source selection for curated-canada-v2. It preserves the v1 Canadian core and adds one hash-pinned, Manitoba-wide, semantic-only disease-observation source to the extended profile. A source must separately retain local-RAG, redistribution, and no-training eligibility in the Canadian source registry before it can enter a release shard.

profiles.description: The v1 compact Canadian field-guidance core, unchanged to preserve its release boundary. Its geographic depth is intentionally uneven and all row-level historical, currency, and live-authority restrictions remain active.

The v1 extended profile plus four reviewed, context-only Manitoba 2026 disease-observation and biosecurity records. It does not authorize crop-protection action, establish a pesticide label use, or imply complete Manitoba crop-protection coverage.
